body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Viable, a deaf-owned provider of video relay service(VRS) for deaf and hard of hearing people, is pleased to announce the launch of its full-featured videophone 'Vpad+' at the pre-press event '2009 CES Unveiled'.
The Vpad+ is a lightweight, standalone videophone that features a 10.2-inch touchscreen monitor, Bluetooth technology, built-in WiFi capability and Dual USB ports.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, Jb Shim, Gini Shim >
